sections.name: settings
sections.notes: Core listener, logging, SOCKS, and HTTP API fields are typed and editable. The HTTP API slice covers token lifetime/refresh, port, allowlists, login posture, and write-only bind targets. Filesystem paths, credentials, API keys, webhook and syslog targets, filename components, and rating keys use write-only replace/clear controls. Tuning, administration, and newer webhook/Sift fields remain partial.

sections.name: debug
sections.notes: Global debug flags and the current per-module boolean, integer, and bounded string logging overrides are typed and editable. Module names are constrained to draft-path-safe identifiers.

sections.name: address_objects
sections.notes: CIDR and FQDN address objects are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: port_objects
sections.notes: Port ranges are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: proto_objects
sections.notes: Protocol identifiers are represented by the typed object editor.

sections.name: detection_profiles
sections.notes: Common detection controls are typed; unknown future profile fields need a schema-backed fallback.

sections.name: captures
sections.notes: Capture posture is typed. Local paths, filename components, destination addresses, and interface names use write-only replace/clear controls and remain redacted in draft responses.

sections.name: content_profiles
sections.notes: Content controls and nested rule action metadata are typed. Session filters and rule match/replacement expressions remain server-side and use write-only rotation; structural rule add and remove operations still require a transaction schema.

sections.name: tls_ca
sections.notes: Authority names and path posture are exposed; filesystem paths support write-only replace or clear and never reach the browser.

sections.name: tls_profiles
sections.notes: All active fields saved by the current Smithproxy TLS profile schema are typed. SNI bypass expressions support write-only replace or clear and never cross the browser boundary.

sections.name: ssh_profiles
sections.notes: Authentication posture is typed; host-key paths support write-only replace or clear while future channel policy fields remain redacted.

sections.name: alg_dns_profiles
sections.notes: The current DNS ALG profile schema is represented by the typed editor.

sections.name: routing
sections.notes: Current DNAT controls are typed; unknown future routing fields need a schema-backed fallback.

sections.name: policy
sections.notes: All fields currently returned by the policy snapshot contract are represented by the typed editor.

sections.name: starttls_signatures
sections.notes: Signature metadata and ordered flow controls are typed. Matcher expressions remain server-side and support write-only replacement; structural add and remove operations still require a transaction schema.

sections.name: detection_signatures
sections.notes: Signature metadata and ordered flow controls are typed. Matcher expressions remain server-side and support write-only replacement; structural add and remove operations still require a transaction schema.

sections.name: script_profiles
sections.notes: Runtime selection is typed; executable paths support write-only replace or clear while script contents remain redacted.

sections.name: auth_profiles
sections.notes: Authentication posture is typed; identity mappings remain redacted.
